sentences.text: Heard on I.A.No.757/2024, application for condonation of delay in M.A.No.6008/2023 and I.A.No.756/2024, application for condonation of delay in M.A.No.6009/2023.
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-IND:29345 2 MA-6008-2023
For the reasons mentioned in the applications, both applications are allowed and the delay is condoned.
Both these appeals have been filed against the common award dated 10.1.2023 passed in Claim Case Nos.198/2021 and 199/2021, thereby challenging quantum of compensation.

2. Short facts of the case are that on 8.4.2019 Imran alongwith his family was returning from Hyderabad to Barwani at around 7.00 in the morning when they reached near Panchala village at highway No.161 the Bolero vehicle in which they were travelling capsized due to rash and negligent driving of the driver.

Resultantly, the appellant in M.A.No.6008/2023 sustained crush injury into Rehan @ Bihan S/O Imran Sheikh (Minor) ... vs Santosh on 8 October, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/32216341/
1
his right hand and the appellant in M.A.No.6009/2023 sustained injuries on various parts of his body.
2.1 Both the appellants have filed claim applications before the claims Tribunal under Section 166 of Motor Vehicles Act.
The claims Tribunal after considering the evidence available on record awarded compensation of Rs.1,35,000/- to Imran and Rs.1,65,000/- to Rehan.
3. Learned counsel for the appellants submits that the amount of compensation as has been awarded by the Tribunal is very less looking to the nature of injuries sustained by the appellants.
He submits that Imran sustained amputation of two of his fingers.
He has sustained permanent disability.
He remained admitted in Ozone Hospital, Akola and Shankutala Hospital.
He submits that he suffered crush injury in right hand and index finger was amputated.
Thus, the Tribunal should have considered the same NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-IND:29345 3 MA-6008-2023 and should have awarded the compensation accordingly.

3.1 As regards appellant Rehan, he points out that Rehan suffered fracture in humerus bone of left hand and radius ulna bone of left hand and also 3rd, 4th and 5th metacarpal bone fractured, which suffered permanent disability.
He was operated upon and rod was implanted into his hand.
However, the claims Tribunal has not considered the same while awarding the compensation.

Thus,
he prays for enhancement of compensation.

4. Per contra, learned counsel for the respondent/Insurance Company refers to the findings recorded by the claims Tribunal in para 28 of the award and submits that there was no material at all, no evidence was led to established that any of the appellants have suffered permanent disability.
In fact there was no amputation of any part of their body and have not suffered grievous injuries resulting in permanent disability.
The compensation awarded is just and proper.
Thus, he prays for dismissal of both the appeals.
5. Heard learned counsel for the parties; perused the record.
6. From the record it is seen that appellant-Imran has suffered crush injury into his right hand, his index finger was fractured.
As far as appellant- Rehan is concerned, he suffered fracture in humerus bone, radius ulna fracture, 3rd, 4th and 5th metacarpal bone was fractured and rod was inserted into his hand.
From the record it is clearly evident that there is no permanent disability to either of the appellants.
Thus, in the considered view of this Court the claims Tribunal has rightly discarded claim of permanent disability.

However, looking to the nature of injuries suffered by the appellants,
in M.A.No.6008/2023 an amount of Rs.40,000/- in lumpsum is NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-IND:29345 4 MA-6008-2023 awarded to the appellant-Imran and in M.A.No.6009/2023 an amount of Rs.50,000/- in lumpsum is awarded to the appellant-Rehan over and above the amount already awarded by the claims Tribunal.
In both appeals the enhanced amount shall carry interest @ 6% per annum from the date of filing of claim application till its payment.
7. With the aforesaid, both appeals stand disposed off.
